mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a temperature of 74 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous council vote. This long-term vision focuses on creating strong neighborhoods, supporting local businesses, and enhancing our natural assets over the coming decades.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, The Mill, and The Bogey Factory, along with live music and the farmers market on October 14.
In a report from the past week, on September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M involving two vehicles.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM today, so you have plenty of time to stop in and enjoy the delicious Georgia Peach flavor of the day.
